props.name: status
props.description: Feedback status: `info` | `success` | `warning` | `danger` | `neutral`.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading (required).

props.name: description
props.description: Body text (required). Override with `children` for rich content.

props.name: href
props.description: Link href. When set (and no `link` snippet is provided) a link is rendered.

props.name: linkText
props.description: Link text. Defaults to the i18n catalog's "Learn more".

props.name: actions
props.description: Action buttons, as data, or a snippet that replaces the whole actions area.

props.name: closable
props.description: Render the close button. Defaults to `false` (not dismissible).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Close button accessible name. Defaults to the i18n catalog's "Close".

props.name: open
props.description: Controls visibility (bindable). Dismissing sets it to `false`; set it back to `true` to show the notification again.

props.name: role
props.description: Live-region role. `"status"` (polite) by default; `"alert"` for urgent.

props.name: inverted
props.description: High-contrast inverse surface (opposite of the page) for maximum visibility.

props.name: plain
props.description: No-surface variant: drop the tinted background and border (the message sits on the page). The status stays visible via the colored FeedbackIcon chip.

props.name: iconShape
props.description: Shape of the FeedbackIcon box — `"rounded"` (default) or a full `"round"` circle.

props.name: iconBox
props.description: FeedbackIcon box override. By default the box is tinted on plain/inverted alerts and transparent on tinted surfaces (so it doesn't clash); set `"tint"` or `"solid"` to force a visible chip on a tinted surface too.

props.name: snack
props.description: Snackbar layout: one compact, vertically-centered row — icon, title and inline actions — in a container that wraps its content. The description is dropped and the icon takes the text color with no box. Meant for the floating `Notification`, not the in-page banner.

props.name: component
props.description: Render arbitrary content as the body instead of `description` / `children` — a Svelte component plus its props. Lets a data-driven notifier carry rich content (a file preview, an avatar row). Ignored in `snack` layout.

props.name: componentProps
props.description: Props passed to `component`.

props.name: onclose
props.description: Called when dismissed.

props.name: onmouseenter
props.description: Called when the pointer enters the live region.

props.name: onmouseleave
props.description: Called when the pointer leaves the live region.

props.name: onfocusin
props.description: Called when focus moves into the live region.

props.name: onfocusout
props.description: Called when focus leaves the live region.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom glyph, forwarded to the FeedbackIcon.

props.name: link
props.description: Custom link content, in place of the `href` link.

props.name: status
props.description: Feedback status: `info` | `success` | `warning` | `danger` | `neutral`.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading; it names the notification.

props.name: description
props.description: Body text. `children` replace it with rich content.

props.name: href
props.description: Link href. When set, and no `link` is given, a link renders.

props.name: linkText
props.description: Link text. Defaults to the catalog's "Learn more".

props.name: actions
props.description: Action buttons as data, or markup of your own.

props.name: closable
props.description: Render the close button. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Close button name. Defaults to the catalog's "Close".

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it shows. Closing hides it and reports `false` through `onOpenChange`; set it back to `true` to show it again.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the close button hides the notification.

props.name: role
props.description: `"status"` (polite live region, default) or `"alert"` (urgent). `"region"` makes a named landmark. `"group"` is for a notification that a live region elsewhere announces, as in a dialog's status area (ADR 0016): it is named by its title and is not a live region itself.

props.name: inverted
props.description: A high-contrast surface, the opposite of the page.

props.name: plain
props.description: No surface: no tint and no border; the coloured icon chip shows the status.

props.name: iconShape
props.description: Shape of the icon box: `"rounded"` (default) or a full `"round"` circle.

props.name: iconBox
props.description: Icon box override. By default the box is tinted on a plain or inverted notification and transparent on a tinted surface; set `"tint"` or `"solid"` to force a chip there too.

props.name: snack
props.description: Snackbar layout: one compact row with the icon, the title and inline actions; the body is left out. Meant for the floating `Notification`.

props.name: component
props.description: A component rendered as the body in place of `description` and `children`, with `componentProps`, so a notifier given data can carry rich content. Ignored in the `snack` layout.

props.name: componentProps
props.description: Props passed to `component`.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called after the close button hid the notification.

props.name: icon
props.description: A custom glyph for the icon.

props.name: link
props.description: Link markup of your own, in place of the `href` link.

props.name: children
props.description: Rich body content, in place of `description`.

notes: Events: `close` and `open-change` after the close button is activated.
